62312.name: Scout Drive · DMG UP
62312.SpecificEffects:
View distance <color=#F74848>+1</color> in Arashi Fog stages.
Can use Code <skill mainSkill=62312>[Radar Detection]</skill>: removes <buf ID=900033>[Stealth]</buf> from all enemy STs within <color=#F74848>4</color> tiles. Triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> in place afterward.
Enables the ST's adjacent <color=#F74848>2</color>-tile area to become a valid attack zone for allied Missile Launcher and Rocket Launcher attacks.
When in combat, enemy DMG Taken <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
